text:
Anonymous post for another group member.  

We are now completing four years on an A5 visa and would like to keep our original citizenship. We would appreciate your advice on the trade-offs between the following options:
• Applying for citizenship based on the Reform conversion we completed, although we do not live as Orthodox Jews and our sons were not converted.
• Applying for permanent residency instead. Is this possible if we are married?
• Applying for citizenship while requesting to keep our original citizenship. I understand that we need to explain why we want to keep it. What is considered a legitimate reason? What happens while the request is being reviewed? Do we remain on A5 status during that time?
